known_issues: Fetch requests are failing consistently (GPIO buttons and debug panel send button not posting)

existing_features.title: Fix the GPIO HTTP POST fetch calls in gpioHttp.ts so that requests to localhost:3000/gpio succeed reliably. Investigate and resolve any issues with the fetch configuration (e.g., no-cors mode preventing response inspection, incorrect headers, request body serialization, or error handling that masks the real failure). Ensure errors are surfaced with meaningful messages.
Fix the DebugHttpPanel component so its manual send button correctly fires the HTTP POST request to localhost:3000/gpio and displays the success or failure result in the panel UI.

projectName: Fix failing fetch requests for GPIO HTTP POST
